enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Remain still. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Move arm under pillow. Bend knees. Straighten legs. Turn onto back. Adjust blanket. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth, showering
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wash body. Turn off shower. Dry body. Exit bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, making coffee with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, bread, and milk. Close refrigerator. Place frying pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off induction cooker. Put eggs on plate. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Pour water into mug. Add coffee powder. Stir coffee. Eat breakfast. Drink coffee.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, seeing patients and handling clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Review patient charts. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Wash hands. Examine patient. Take vital signs. Administer medication. Update records. Consult with colleagues. Attend meeting. Perform procedures. Write prescriptions. Talk to patient. Clean equipment. Walk to next patient.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at work
enriched_activities.desc: Go to cafeteria. Buy lunch. Sit at table. Eat lunch. Drink water. Dispose of trash. Return to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical work, patient care and record documentation
enriched_activities.desc: Check patient list. Enter patient room. Wash hands. Examine patient. Change dressing. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Update chart. Order tests. Consult with doctor. Attend training. Document notes. Review lab results. Discharge patient. Walk to nurses station.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit. Look out window. Check phone. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk to house. Arrive at door.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and eating
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Cook. Turn off induction cooker. Put food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Continue watching. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down. Turn off TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming and tidying the living room
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum. Turn on vacuum. Vacuum floor. Move furniture. Vacuum under sofa. Turn off vacuum. Unplug vacuum. Pick up items from floor. Place items in basket. Wipe coffee table. Put vacuum away.
Turn on bathroom light. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wash body. Wash hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Brush teeth. Put on pajamas.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer for personal tasks and winding down
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Log in. Check emails. Browse internet. Watch videos. Type documents. Save files. Close computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up. Walk to bed. Sit on bed. Read book. Turn off light. Lie down.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Remain still. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Move arm under pillow. Bend knees. Straighten legs. Continue sleeping.
